source_claim: AlphaEvolve orchestrates multiple LLM work classes such as proposal generation, critique, feedback, and prompt improvement with separately meaningful scheduling and reward behavior
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has configured role-backend indices, backend metadata role matching, configured reward-accounted roles, feedback-grader reward wiring, per-role logical call limits, role provider-attempt, token, configured-cost, and latency limits, scheduler-policy telemetry, reward-accounted versus telemetry-only status, role selection state-owner telemetry, opt-in role-scoped local UCB selection, role scheduler state snapshots, scheduler-state restore validation, runtime LLM accounting summaries, and LLM budget report role budgets. It does not claim role-specific backend-pool policy, role-specific exploration parameters, role reward normalization reports, role outcome-attribution datasets, async role work queues, cross-role interference analysis, calibrated role reward policy, experiment-owned quota policy, fast/strong model-mix reports, resume replay experiment reports, or role-specific budget behavior reports.
